BATTLESPEECH: More hostiles! You've made a big mistake by breaking in here.
Sorry about the gate, I couldn't find the doorbell.
The prisoners are escaping! We need more men!
RESERVED
These guys are trying to escape!
Hey! HEY YOU! Did you just see a zombie chick run through here? Help us, and we'll help you!
Don't listen to him Andy, it's a trick...!
They're trying to play us for fools! You saw what they did to Frank!
Look, we just want to know if-
Back off, Mary Poppins!
You asked for it.
They're here for us, Johnny! I told you they'd come! I TOLD YOU!
Oh. What fine specimens! But you do not belong here! Guards, escort these gentlemen to the exit!
There's something fishy about this place. And it's not just the smell.
It has functional nostrils, too? Fascinating...
Oh the horrors! I can't take it anymore! Please. Let me... taste your... blood water.
There is no escape from MY prison! I will crush you!
Wake up Frankie, the guests are here. Wake up! And make Daddy proud!
RAAAWWR!
This prison is one hell of a freak show...
That uniform! Not these guys again...
It's like they're everywhere!
Ah, the meddlers...I'm sure I'll be rewarded handsomely for bringing back your heads, and thwarting your disturbance of our operation here!
Don't start what you can't finish, boys.
You’re not getting that tape!
Give us the tape, this is getting old.
You want it that bad, huh? Catch it if you can!
Isn't this a long row to hoe. Looks like we're hoofing it from here.
It was fun while it lasted, right? And look, a welcoming party!
Mmmgghrrr!
Hey, wait! You're not like the rest of them! Who are you? Can you talk?
We're just passing through. Move, or die.
Amazing!
Let's put down our weapons. We are not your enemies.
We were a group of people devoted to find a cure for... your condition. But things started happening…
Assassinations… Kidnappings… Someone didn't want us to continue our research.
Those of us that survived – we fled from the Utopia, and ended up hiding here.
This place isn't much better. The village is infested with some kind of cult.
They sacrifice innocent people. Will you help us?
Tell us how to find that Utopia. Then we will help you.
If you can rid us from this zealous cult – I'll take you there myself.
All in a days work!
Do you know anything about the prison?
A prison? Here?
No, but not far. They were conducting experiments there, on the prisoners.
Then the ZPCI showed up! Those guys just won't leave us alone.
The ZPCI? Are you sure? But they protect us - they're the good guys!
Somehow, I don't think so...
You are here to join our ranks? Then prove yourselves!
Lay down your arms, I... *cough* accept your request.
Your membership fees are too high. I'd rather kill you.
Heretic! My Master will have your heads!
We don't fear death!
Our master will save us from the undead!
What are the tattoos for? You all have them.
When things started to get ugly, we got them made in secret so we knew who we could trust.
They look familiar, somehow.
Sacrifice the intruders! Their blood will save us from death!
But nothing will save you from ME.
The master will be pleased! Die for us now!
You first. I insist!
It's their leader! If we can take him out, their cult is finished!
Ow, my head...hurting...I've felt this before!
Could it be...?
Oh, it’s you! You always give me trouble! And here I was, having SUCH a good time.
Not him again!
My loyal subjects are on their way here. This time, you're mine!
Let's break this bowl of fruit before the guards arrive!
No! Not again! I would've gotten away with it...if it weren't for you meddling kids!
Our master - is he one of them? He's a zombie too?
I don't believe it! All those things he said...*sobbing*
It's true, Carl, it's true!...He lied to us.
We have no reason to fight for him anymore. Let us leave this place.
Get them! We can't leave anyone alive! DO IT!
This train is old, we'll need more fuel to get out of their range! There should be more coal in the back of the train. Let's hurry!
That's about as far as you'll go, troublemakers. The Captain wants you dead.
Spare some change?
Ow! That...hurt.
Wait a sec...that wasn't a zombie!
Well I couldn't just give him my hard earned cash, now could I?
Tickets, please!
We don't have any.
No tickets, no ride! Get off my train! GET OFF!
Just our luck. Why does everything break around us?
At least we got those ZPCI off our backs. They don't seem to be following us anymore.
These tunnels should lead us to Hew. We need to head through it if we're to reach Utopia!
The air in here... it feels different.
That one looks just like Sonny! Haha!
Hey, it kinda does!
I’m not amused.
You are my sunshine, my only sunshine...
Stop that.
I'm freaking out... man...
Oi, Miller, look! There are still people down here!
Ey, I'd give these guys some masks, if they breathe in any more of this stuff they're done for!
Put down your weapons! Resistance will be met by force.
I don't usually resort to violence, but I've got a major headache right now.
Wow, those workers are really going for it. And they're all headed to the mayor's office!
A bit more attention than I would have liked, but at least we're moving forward.
Biker girl is here too.
Quick. Cover your face.
We're outnumbered! Where are those ZPCI when you need them?!
Hello boys, did you miss me?
Felicity! No! I thought you were dead! Don't let her come near me!
That ambassador was talking about a plan. What are they planning?
I won't let you kill me, you filthy corpse! I'm the Mayor!
Get out! Get out or my guards will make you! GUARDS!
I may be blind, but there's no mistaking that smell. Can you take him out?
Yes, I...I suppose I can. Ugh...I don't feel too well.
It will wear off eventually. You need to focus!
Notice the grey 'ring' in the lower middle panel, around the exclamation mark. Wait until it turns blue.
Once the ring is blue, click on the enemy to target him. Your abilities will appear around him.
He doesn't look too happy.
He's enraged! You'll have to defend yourself! Get ready!
Target yourself instead of the enemy this turn, so you can use your defensive ability.
To find out more about an ability, hold your mouse over its icon for a couple of seconds.
Good job, Sonny. Keep going, and stay alert. There will be more of them ahead.
Who are you? How did you find this place?
Where is the ambassador?
Ambassador? I don't know what you're talking about...
Do you know anything about a secret weapon?
You've come to the wrong place. There's nothing for you here.
Really? So what's with the high level security?
We're hunting down a target. You better leave before somebody gets hurt.
If you kill me, we won't be able to apprehend the target...
My team will have no choice but to bomb the entire region. Everything will burn, including you!
It's a bomb! Quick, dismantle it before it explodes!
This must be the target that Warden was talking about.
What IS that thing?
Criminals everywhere... This world is truly rotten.
Lady, you should be happy we killed your target for you.
Alas, only I may judge the enemy! Turn yourselves in.
Hey! That suit would look really good on Veradux. Mind if we take it?
Let them kill me, Dave! Let them kill me, and we will win.
Intruders! Stay still, let me find your melting point...
Those orbs...
The Baron!
Make sure no one leaves this place. Alive or dead. Disintegrate everything.
We'll take care of it Capt'n!
Quickly, come with me! We need to get underground, we can get out of here by train.
I can see right through you!
What can we do? They're getting closer. They're going to hang me for this!
Not to worry Mayor. Plans are in motion to subdue the masses once again.

CLASSDESCRIPT: Wild and animalistic, the Biological line harnesses its power from strength and speed. You have the choice of ripping your prey apart with advanced physical combat, or melting them down with your toxic arsenal of poisons. This is probably the most straightforward class to play. Recommended for beginners.

If insanity were a weapon, then this would be its form. The Psychological line is heavily based on directly attacking the enemy’s mind. The abilities you have available are often quite situational, but some of the most powerful. You may betray or even sacrifice your friends if you let the darkness consume you.

Strong and stable, the Hydraulic line derives its power from its mastery of water. You can use it to bolster your physical strength, or channel it against the enemy to bring about their icy doom. Wielding such powers allows you greater control over the battle, as well as powerful survival and team support options.
This class in only available on ArmorGames.com. Click here if you wish to play it!

I'd like to tell you more about myself, but I can't.
I don't even know my real name.
It all started a year ago, on that dreadful ship...
I'll never forget the ship.
I died there.
But somebody brought me back.
Wake up, Sonny! Let's hope you're not too far gone.
...Sonny?
Hey, would you look at that! Maybe there's hope for you yet.
Come on, let's move! We need to get off this ship!
Who are you?
I'm Louis. Just a friend. Can you walk?
Yeah.
You'll need a weapon. Grab something.
Uh...how about this pipe?
Sounds fine, take it! This way!
Sonny... Take this.
Louis, I don't know what to do or where to go! I don't remember anything!
Just take it, please...
What is it?
It's a tape. Maybe it can help you.
Louis? I don't need this! I need to remember! I need to-
We reached it just a couple of days after killing that Paladin...
I thought it would be the answer to everything.
The light at the end of the tunnel...
But no. Oh, no... This is where everything began.

Or perhaps pitch your own character against a friend's, using the 'PvP Arena' option. Visit www.ArmorGames.com for more games (including the first chapter of Sonny) and check for updates, in case we add some new Zones for you to play in. Seeya next time!

MANUALEX: You can just start a new game right now! Make sure that you have the tutorial level enabled. All the basics will be explained within the first few fights. Just listen to the dialogue and read the text. But if you insist on reading... Sonny is a turn based fighting game. You choose what move your character makes in his turn by first selecting WHO you want to make a move on, and then you can choose WHAT you want to do to that target. For example, if you want to attack an enemy, you click on the enemy first, then you can choose to attack him. If you want to heal a team mate, select that character and you will be able to choose a move to use on him. You may only have 8 moves 'equipped' in any fight, and you configure this from your Abilities menu. Some moves can be equipped more than once, so that you can use it more often.
They just indicate the element that the ability is classified as: Physical, Cosmic, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Shadow, and Poison.

During battle, you can cannot directly control the actions of your team mates, but you can tell them how to behave. You can also equip your team mates with items and weapons, by going into the inventory screen.

Strength and Instinct are just co-efficients for your abilities. Speed is also a co-efficient, but to only a few abilities. Speed also increases your critical strike chance and dodge/accuracy. Vitality increases your Health. Piercing increases critical strike chance, and Defense decreases damage taken.

It's mainly about the Strategy and Abilities that you use. Observe the enemy carefully, and look into your entire Ability tree to find ways to beat them. If you need more help, then try visiting the Sonny forums on ArmorGames for guides and walkthroughs.

NAVTEXT: Your game has been saved!
Psst! Mate, come over here. I got what you need. Best quality goods. Don't be afraid, just come closer. I won't hurt you.
This is no regular priion, there seems to be blood tracks all over the place. This particular one is still fresh, and it smells very strange. Definitely not something natural...
Friedrich Nietzsche once said... 'Gaze long into the abyss, and the abyss will also gaze into you.
The lights are searching for us. They know we're here...

What are you doing here? Leave this place, there is nothing for you here. This village is crawling with zombies and madmen. We're trying to keep a low profile, please go away before you draw any unwanted attention.
It's not working anymore, the water is frozen. Luckily, I have other ways to maintain my hydration levels. But the blood here... It seems familiar.

The car that Felicity tried to use to escape. Veradux shot it with an Electro-Bolt to shut off the engine and stop her from getting away, but it looks like the battery was permanently damaged. In the car there was a tape player. I still can't believe it... How is that song going to help me with anything? Maybe Louis gave me the wrong tape. Better keep it anyway, just in case. Felicity seemed to think it was important.
Tonight it seems so large and so red. Something is amiss with the sky. It seems as if the night is lasting forever.
There is a structure far in the distance. It's not in walking distance from here, but there is a terrace nearby that is within reach.

Good evening, stranger. I've been sitting here, waiting for someone to finally drive the train for a long time. I wouldn't go further into the other compartments though. The show-biz folks were having a party back there until... he showed up.

There are rising concerns over the disappearance of the renowned magician, Clemons Bugiel. He has been reported missing for over three weeks, and the authorities have had no luck in their search. Bugiel is a world famous illusionist, known for his tricks that include disguise, mirage, and hypnosis. He was last seen at his magic show 'The Floating Apple' before vanishing without a trace. Is this another one of his tricks, or is for real? The authorities fear the worst.
There is a torn piece of paper in here. Names and numbers are on the list. Most of them have been crossed out.
There's Tomato Soup, Broccoli Spaghetti... and the rest of the menu is covered in blood. But there is a strange smell. It smells of chlorine.
Amateurs! Next time, before you go fetching coal in the back, at least make sure someone's driving the damn train!
Everyone who walks through this tunnel is covered by the green slime. Now no one will be able to tell the difference between a man and a zombie.

Attention! The air in this tunnel is toxic and highly dangerous. It is recommended that all personnel wear gas-masks for their own health and safety. Symptoms of illness include decreased brain activity, increased levels of dopamine, and severe hallucinations. Prolonged exposure could lead to death. The nature and origin of this substance is still under investigation.
The A is missing, but the sign still gets the message across.

Revolution... War... It's the best time for business. Dead people just waiting for their things to be looted. Yet both sides are trying to get their hands on the best weapons and armor. As for me? I'm not from around here, so I'm neutral. Why don't you come inside and have a look around?
Here it is again... This blood trail. Where is it coming from? Where does it lead? I'm definately not going down there to find out...
There is chaos as riots break loose. The workers are advancing towards the town hall. The government isn't responding lightly either...
NAVTEXT2: Sonny 2 is an RPG-Strategy game. Your objective is to defeat the enemies and reach the end of the Zone. To fight the next enemy, press the red spinning button. But before you do that, I suggest you assign your abilties first (You have 5 base Ability Points to spend). Press the 'Abilities' button on the grey panel below. Good luck, fish.

You leveled up in the previous battle! As a result, you were rewarded 1 Ability Point to develop your character with, and several Stat Points. You may access these using the 'Abilities' button. If you are unhappy with the way you have distributed your points, you can press the 'Re-Spec' button, and your points will be reset (at a cost).

You have found an item in the previous battle. Item drops are displayed to you in the Victory screen, but you will not have them in your Inventory unless you take them and put them there. You may press the 'Inventory' button on the grey panel below to view and equip the items for you and your team members.

You may have noticed that during battle, there are some colorful buttons on the bottom left panel. You may use these buttons to direct your team members. Whilst you cannot control them fully, you can at least tell them how you want them to act.

If you press the 'Map' button, you can see all the Zones available in 'Sonny 2.' Once you have completed all the battles in a Zone, it will allow you to go to other Zones that are connected to it. Zones that you cannot access will appear grey, and ones which you can access will appear blue.

It is also in Felicity's interest to see the mayor overthrown. You are now able to use her in your team setup. Press the inventory button to display the team members, and SHIFT+CLICK to activate or deactive them.
SHOP: I got what you need mate. Except soap. Someone's taken all the soap. That's why it always stinks around here. But don't worry mate, you'll get used to it.
Sssh! Keep your voices down, lads. We're amongst enemies here. In fact, I don't even know if I can trust you. Just buy what you need and leave.
Listen. I'm a collector of antique artifacts, and I usually don't sell what I find, but since we're in tough financial times... Consider yourself lucky.
I'm fine, I'm fine! My nose is bleeding a little but I'll be alright. You need any more gear? I've got another suitcase of things for you to buy.
Police? Proletariat? I don't care, I buy and sell everything from everyone. But do keep your distance, stranger. You're in the city now.
